title: GTA6 Radio Stations and Podcasts Previewed in New Community Leak
description: Six new radio stations and the first-ever podcasts coming to GTA6 have been previewed. Discover the diverse music scene of Leonida.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Radio Stations and Podcasts Previewed in New Community Leak

Recent community reports shared on Reddit (r/GTA6) have provided a first look at six radio stations and their respective hosts coming to *Grand Theft Auto VI* (note: sourced from the community, subject to official updates). As a core pillar of the franchise's identity, the music and audio experience in Leonida is shaping up to be more diverse and immersive than ever before. Furthermore, the game will introduce on-demand podcasts for the first time in series history.

### Six Diverse Radio Stations Coming to Leonida

The previewed stations cover a vast spectrum of genres, perfectly reflecting the distinct cultural backdrop of the setting:

*   **Cocoteo FM**: Leonida's home for the best of modern Latin music. Hosted by El Martillo and La Gata, it features everything from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton, described as "el party que nunca se apaga."
*   **Back Country Radio**: MW and Delta Dawne blast renegade country music to Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, and beyond. They are joined by roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and Delta's not-so-secret lover Mud Dog Mike, checking in from his Grassrivers airboat.
*   **The Chamber 106.6**: Crushing metal has landed in Leonida. DJ Kerry and DJ Tom channel the region's deep metal roots with classic metal from the '80s and beyond.
*   **Flash FM**: The iconic Vice City institution delivers the best in pop music with Robyn and Alex, guaranteed to make you dance anywhere in the Goodtime State.
*   **Dirty South Classics**: Trick and Trina deliver southern hospitality by blasting regional rap and hip-hop classics, repping Leonida and the South from the beach to the block.
*   **AfroBank FM**: Burna and Palmsy curate the best in African music, ranging from 20th-century classics and hidden gems to contemporary sounds like amapiano, 3-step, and more.

### Gameplay Innovation: On-Demand Podcasts and Earphones

In a major shift for the franchise, *Grand Theft Auto VI* introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for the first time ever. Players will be able to listen to both radio broadcasts and podcasts not only while inside vehicles, but also on foot by using newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their in-game smartphones.

Previews for these six stations can be found in the Music section of the official site, with more information—including details about the game's dynamic score—expected soon.

## Editor's Take
Music has always been the heartbeat of the GTA universe, and this leak points to an unprecedented level of audio depth in GTA6. By blending culturally rich regional radio stations with modern podcast formats and portable listening options, Rockstar is clearly doubling down on immersion. While this information originates from community sources, it sets high expectations for how players will experience the soundscapes of Leonida.
